review.use_summary: Illustrated AutoDock Vina docking results for LCA and AlphaFold-predicted TULP3 using PyMOL v2.5.
review.implementation_scope_note: Docking and structure prediction were separate programs. Structural alignments are mentioned as performed earlier, but the paragraph does not identify their exact PyMOL command or establish a docking calculation within PyMOL.

review.use_summary: Visualized a mononucleosome based on PDB5NL0 with PyMOL v3.0; separately aligned the predicted MYC/MAX-TFAP2C complex to PDB8J0K with align and calculated electrostatic surface charge using the APBS plugin.
review.implementation_scope_note: AlphaFold-Multimer/COSMIC2 prediction is separate. PyMOL align performs correspondence/refinement beyond a supplied-pair rigid fit; APBS electrostatics requires its own solver,charge/protonation and grid settings. Rendering a coloured surface alone does not reproduce APBS.

review.use_summary: Reported three-dimensional reconstruction of Dip-C models in PyMOL v2.5.3, following a cited prior procedure.
review.implementation_scope_note: Dip-C/hickit generated haplotype-imputed contacts in a separate pipeline. The named paragraph does not supply the PyMOL reconstruction script,coordinate representation or rendering settings; do not infer contact phasing or coordinate reconstruction algorithms from the program name.

review.use_summary: Linked two Pep-Fold ARM structural models in parallel using PyMOL v2.0 bond building before coarse-grained simulation.
review.implementation_scope_note: CafeMol generated the molecular-dynamics trajectory and distance distribution. Adding an explicitly requested bond is distinct from peptide prediction,energy minimization or trajectory simulation.

review.use_summary: Manually adjusted ZorA-tail conformations in PyMOL v2.5, inspected predicted structures with v2.5.4 to identify tail starts, prepared figures with v2.5.4/v3.0.2 and calculated electrostatic maps with the APBS plugin.
review.implementation_scope_note: GROMACS/CHARMM27 minimized the structures; ColabFold predicted them, MUSCLE transferred tail boundaries, and MOLEonline analysed pathways/hydrophobicity. These are separate operations. Manual conformations,colour/view settings and APBS parameters are not fully specified by these paragraphs.

supporting_evidence.section: Methods / Bioinformatic analyses of ZorA motor and tail lengths

review.use_summary: Illustrated the selected highest-scoring AlphaFold3 multimer/docking prediction using PyMOL v2.5.8.
review.implementation_scope_note: AlphaFold Server generated and ranked the predicted structures. PyMOL visualization does not establish protein interaction or docking accuracy; exact reported build/settings remain separate from the tested open-source edition.

review.use_summary: Listed PyMOL v3.4.19 among the software used in the study.
review.implementation_scope_note: The only named paragraph is a software list. It does not establish a particular rendering,alignment,measurement or modelling command. Retain the literal version rather than silently converting it to a known open-source tag or inventing a paper-specific operation.

review.use_summary: Aligned extracted predicted membrane-binding-domain structures to the rat PHPLCdelta crystal structure PDB1MAI and calculated RMSD with the PyMOL super alignment tool.
review.implementation_scope_note: MAFFT handled sequence alignment, while AlphaFold2/ESMFold supplied structures. super establishes structural correspondences/refinement and must not be replaced silently by align or a rigid fit of supplied pairs. Version and exact super/refinement parameters are unstated here.

review.use_summary: Generated replisome structural figures with PyMOL v2.5.4 alongside UCSF ChimeraX.
review.implementation_scope_note: Coot/PHENIX model adjustment and real-space refinement are separate. One figure used an additional four-base-pair segment whose density was too poor for deposition; a deposited PDB alone does not reproduce that figure.

review.use_summary: Calculated listed distances with the PyMOL distance function during manual inspection of resolved experimental structures for highly deleterious popEVE mutations.
review.implementation_scope_note: The paper restricted inspection to resolved mutation sites and prioritized interacting structures. Exact atom selections,states,measurement mode and version are unstated here. Distances are geometric observations,not mutation pathogenicity or binding-energy estimates.

review.use_summary: Visualized crystal structures using PyMOL v2.4.1 in the PARP-trapping study.
review.implementation_scope_note: The same paragraph primarily describes wet-lab fractionation/immunoblotting. Those assays and trapping measurements were not performed by PyMOL; it supplies the stated structure visualization only.

review.use_summary: Performed structural alignments and figure rendering of experimental/AlphaFold3 AR-PTGES3 complex models with PyMOL.
review.implementation_scope_note: The alignment command/version is unstated. The paper explicitly colours AlphaFold confidence red for very high and blue for very low; retain that mapping rather than automatically applying a different pLDDT palette. Confidence is not experimental validation.

review.use_summary: Visualized protein structures from PDB6KN8,5LGD and5DO7 with PyMOL for Troponin-T,CD36 and ABCG5/ABCG8.
review.implementation_scope_note: The URL ending pymol.org/2 is not a software build/version declaration. Accession,assembly,chain,atom/state selection and view choices remain explicit requirements; no prediction or alignment command is specified.

review.use_summary: Used explicitly open-source PyMOL v1.7.6.0 for molecular modelling/rendering of a c-Myc/Max heterodimer,choosing a Gln60 rotamer and manually setting K392 chi1-chi4 to gauche+,trans,gauche-,trans.
review.implementation_scope_note: The chosen rotamer and torsions were manually selected for packing/clash considerations. A new-version default rotamer or a generic point-set fit does not reproduce those choices or establish an energy-minimized model.

review.use_summary: Aligned AlphaFold2 wild-type/mutant JAG1 residues31-333 in PyMOL v2.5.4 and quantified local C-alpha RMSD within plus/minus15 residues of each variant.
review.implementation_scope_note: The paragraph does not specify whether each local window was refitted or measured in the global alignment frame; that must remain explicit before replay. FoldX and Rosetta separately estimated stability changes; RMSD is not delta-delta-G.

review.use_summary: Prepared images of the determined apo-PRMT9 structure in PyMOL.
review.implementation_scope_note: XDS,MR-Rosetta,Coot,Buster and MolProbity performed separate processing,model-building,refinement and validation tasks. PyMOL version,representations and view parameters are unstated here.

review.use_summary: Modelled PRKCI variants from PDB1ZRZ with a backbone-independent rotamer in PyMOL and measured them with the Wizard Measurement tool.
review.implementation_scope_note: The exact rotamer,state/atom selections,measurement types and software version are unstated. Explicit distance/angle/torsion arithmetic does not by itself reproduce the mutagenesis wizard or a manually chosen conformation.

review.use_summary: Created native/variant TMEM184B structure visualizations and overlays using PyMOL v2.6.
review.implementation_scope_note: AlphaFold/MMseqs2 generated structures; pLDDT/PAE and Ramachandran criteria informed quality selection,and GPS6.0 predicted phosphorylation sites. Loop truncation and model selection are separate explicit choices,not automatic consequences of PyMOL rendering.

review.use_summary: Adjusted and visualized the PDB4A69 NCoR2 DAD-domain/HDAC3 structure in PyMOL v2.5.5.
review.implementation_scope_note: The exact adjustment operations,conformer choices and rendering settings are unstated. Retain the reported build label and do not invent a mutation,refinement or energy method.

review.use_summary: Generated structural figures using PyMOL v2.5.4 for the human JAG1/NOTCH2 modelling analysis.
review.implementation_scope_note: The paragraph also describes alignment to rat JAG1/NOTCH1 PDB5UK5,but does not explicitly name that alignment command as PyMOL align or super. AlphaFold2/ColabFold,SignalP,PDBsum and PDBePISA have distinct prediction/annotation/interface roles.
